A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same NAPPure research work. All 12 pages, including equations, figures, tables, references, and Appendix A1–A5, are readable and support a complete comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original classification experiments on GTSRB and CIFAR-10, ImageNet results in Appendix A1/Table 7, and sensitivity and robustness analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and appendix analyses, with three revised aggregate accuracy values in Tables 1–2.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same three-term objective, alternating image/perturbation optimization, auxiliary model, and NAPPure-joint interpolation procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate GTSRB, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet, including the same additive, blur, patch, flow-field, composite, and varying-parameter attack scenarios. ImageNet coverage already appears in v1's appendix.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within Tables 1–3 and 7. The undefended classifiers, AT, DiffPure, LM, and NAPPure variants retain their respective participation.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 and Appendix Table 8 retain identical sample selection, attack configurations, evaluation metrics, classifiers, iteration budgets, and hyperparameters. The revised averages do not establish any experimental rerun or protocol change.

E4.justification: The purification examples, hyperparameter sensitivity, composite-attack comparison, iteration analysis, auxiliary-architecture comparison, and attack-size generalization tests are unchanged in Section 5.3 and Appendix A3–A5.

E5.justification: Neither version adds repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Changes to three reported averages concern result values, not uncertainty reporting practices.

E6.justification: Table 1 revises undefended average robust accuracy from 18.95% to 18.94% and NAPPure average clean accuracy from 93.55% to 93.80%. Table 2 revises NAPPure average robust accuracy from 66.94% to 68.55%. These values match the rounded means of the unchanged displayed component scores. The clean-average correction places NAPPure slightly above NAPPure-joint's 93.75% on GTSRB.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, likelihood decomposition, optimization derivation, assumptions, and additive-case reduction in Equations 1–10 are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about generalizing purification to non-additive perturbations, implementing representative transformations, and improving robustness. No contribution is added or redefined.

C2.justification: Interpretations of semantic drift, traffic-sign sensitivity, hyperparameter effects, over-optimization, and attack-size generalization remain unchanged, as do qualifications about known transformation types and supported attack parameters.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility information in Algorithm 1, Section 5.1, and Appendix A1–A2/Table 8 is identical. No code or data access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: The same 48 references and related-work discussion are retained, with unchanged positioning relative to adversarial training, purification, and image restoration.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 15 October 2025 to v2 dated 31 May 2026. The title, authors, prose, terminology, section order, and appendix structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–5, Tables 1–8, Algorithm 1, captions, and page arrangement retain their existing designs and placement. The numerical substitutions in Tables 1–2 do not change their display structure.

improvement.justification: The revised summary values improve numerical consistency with the displayed component scores, particularly NAPPure's CIFAR-10 robust average of 68.55% instead of 66.94% and GTSRB clean average of 93.80% instead of 93.55%. This is a limited improvement in reporting accuracy; the underlying experimental evidence, appendices, method, and main conclusions remain unchanged.
